title: Near-death experience after poisoning: out-of-body travel and white light

tellings.quote: was delivered DOA to a clinic in pasel Germany from Austria and uh I had not had a heartbeat for almost 40 minutes

plain: In 1970 a man was poisoned in Austria and arrived dead at a clinic in Passau, Germany, and while he had no heartbeat he says he left his body, traveled, and saw a white light. Joe McMoneagle tells Michels this as his own near-death experience, saying he "had not had a heartbeat for almost 40 minutes" before he was revived.
